collectible:1.text: Destroying the first gives the player the "Revolt Against the Revolting" awards; destroying all gives the "Revolution Wind-up" award. There are a total of 16 scattered across the game. These wind-up dolls are similar to the other collectibles found in RE Engine games of the series where they make a sound once players are close enough.

collectible:2.text: The Operative Profile is a menu in Resident Evil Survival Unit that serves as a part of how players improve their combat power in customization of Operative Treasures and Jewel Enhancement of those treasures, inspired by how the Treasure items in prior games, such as Resident Evil 4 (2005) function. Players are only able to access Operative Treasures upon reaching Mansion Lv. 22.

collectible:3.text:
About the Blue Medallions is a file-type item in Resident Evil 4. The note is found in plain sight tacked on a tree in the farm area in Chapter 1-1. It glows a distinct blue color, and the first Blue Medallion is hanging from a branch on the same tree. 15 blue medallions...
7 in the farm... 8 in the cemetery...

For those of you who destroy 10 or more
will be awarded...

(The rest is illegible.)
